{
  "name": "gatekeeper",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Your open PRs and what each waits on (/gates): the template boxes only you can tick, CodeRabbit threads and change requests, Codecov, CI, conflicts and drafts ready for you, sorted so what needs you comes first. A band above the prompt counts them; Claude can ask through the gates tool.",
  "author": {
    "name": "David Coulson",
    "url": "https://github.com/davidcoulson"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Search",
      "description": "The GitHub search for your PRs.",
      "default": "is:pr is:open author:@me archived:false sort:updated-desc"
    },
    "yourBoxes": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Boxes only you tick",
      "description": "Words that mark a PR-template checkbox as yours to tick (case-insensitive substrings).",
      "default": [
        "built and ran",
        "human",
        "manually tested",
        "tested locally",
        "tested it locally",
        "i have tested",
        "i have read",
        "i confirm",
        "i agree",
        "verified this change",
        "pre-commit",
        "reviewed my own",
        "self-review"
      ]
    },
    "pollMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh every (minutes)",
      "description": "How often to read GitHub. Every session shares one read (~/.cache/crab-workshop/gatekeeper.json), so this is how often GitHub is asked at all, not per session; 0 reads only on /gates.",
      "default": 15
    },
    "readyLimits": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ready-PR limits",
      "description": "Repos or owners that cap how many open, non-draft PRs a contributor without write access may have, as owner=N or owner/repo=N, comma-separated. A green draft there waits instead of asking you to mark it ready while you're at the cap.",
      "default": "tinkerologie=2"
    }
  },
  "license": "MIT"
}
